item.title: Lamination Pressure Governs the Effectiveness of Sn Buffer Layers in Low-Pressure All-Solid-State Lithium Metal Batteries
item.description:

ACS Energy Letters | 🔬 Research Article | 🔓 Open Access
💡 High-pressure lamination is shown to be decisive for Sn buffer layers in low-pressure all-solid-state Li batteries. Decoupling lamination from stack pressure reveals that good Sn–solid electrolyte contact enables Li⁺ transport and deposition beneath the buffer, improving Li utilization, lowering overpotential, and suppressing voids and short circuits at 1 MPa.

ACS Energy Letters | 🔬 Research Article
💡 This study uniquely links solvent impurity origins to battery performance during electrolyte scale-up, classifying impurities by synthesis pathway. It reveals a critical removal–generation trade-off in purification and identifies water, alkoxides, and amines as key degraders. The transferable qualification framework enables reliable upscaling of fluorinated ether electrolytes for lithium metal batteries.

item.title: Simultaneous Bulk Doping and Surface reconstruction Engineering by SeS 2 Treatment Enable Stable High‐Voltage Performance of LiCoO 2 at 4.6 V
item.description:

Small | 🔬 Research Article
💡 SeS₂ treatment simultaneously bulk-dopes LiCoO₂ with Se and reconstructs its surface, forming a Li₂SO₃/Li₂SO₄/Li₂SeO₄ heterojunction coating. This stabilizes lattice oxygen, suppresses phase transitions and interfacial reactions, and builds an inorganic-rich CEI layer. The synergy enables 80.6% capacity retention at 4.6 V after 400 cycles versus 37.8% for pristine, offering a general bulk–surface strategy for high-voltage cathodes.

This mitigates cooperative distortion and P′2–P2–OP4 phase transitions, enabling 197.76 mAh g⁻¹ at 0.2C and 99.35% retention after 100 cycles at 20C. item.title: Unveiling the Mechanism of V 6 O 13 /MnO 2 Heterojunction for High‐Performance Aqueous Zinc‐Ion Batteries via Combined Experiments, DFT, and Deep Learning
item.description:
هتروجانکشن V6O13/MnO2 با میدان الکتریکی داخلی، سد انتشار Zn2+ را کاهش و ظرفیت و پایداری باتری آبی روی-یون را بهطور چشمگیری بهبود میدهد.
Carbon Energy | 🔬 Research Article | 🔓 Open Access
💡 The novelty lies in constructing a V6O13/MnO2 heterojunction with a built-in electric field, combining experiments, DFT, and deep learning. It significantly lowers Zn2+ diffusion barrier (0.55 to 0.38 eV), boosts conductivity, and achieves 97.8% retention over 10,000 cycles. This offers a high-performance, stable AZIB cathode.
🏷 aqueous zinc-ion battery · V6O13/MnO2 heterojunction · DFT · deep learning · Zn2+ diffusion

item.title: Functional‐Group Engineering for Durable Solid Electrolyte Interphase Toward Aqueous Copper Batteries
item.description:
با مهندسی گروههای عاملی، یک SEI هیبریدی آلی-معدنی روی الکترود Cu ساخته شد که برگشتپذیری Cu2+ و پایداری باتری آبی مس را بهشدت بهبود میدهد.
Advanced Energy Materials | 🔬 Research Article
💡 This work pioneers functional-group engineering of an organic-inorganic hybrid SEI on Cu electrodes for aqueous copper batteries. By combining fluorine and sulfur additives, it achieves high modulus (54.7 GPa) and fast Cu²⁺ transport, enabling 2000 h cycling and 2200-cycle full cells. This establishes a structure-function relationship guiding durable SEI design, advancing practical aqueous copper battery deployment.
🏷 aqueous copper battery · solid electrolyte interphase · functional-group engineering · Cu2+ reversibility · fluorinated additives

item.title: Rechargeable Seawater Battery Coupled to Solar Seawater Desalination With a Mutual Enhancement Effect
item.description:

Advanced Materials | 🔬 Research Article
💡 ε-MnO₂ acts as both an ion-storage cathode for rechargeable seawater batteries and a photothermal material for solar desalination. Integrating the two yields a mutual enhancement effect: battery capacity and seawater evaporation both increase during charge/discharge, unlike traditional integrations. This bifunctional coupling offers a new strategy for combined energy storage and clean water production.

item.title: Medium‐Entropy‐Vacancy Engineering Unlocks Energy‐Power Trade‐Off Reconciliation in Sodium‐Ion Hybrid Capacitors
item.description:
مهندسی آنتروپی-تهی‌جای متوسط در کاتد Na3Fe0.6Al0.4V(PO4)3، مبادله انرژی-توان در خازن‌های هیبریدی سدیم-یون را حل می‌کند.
Advanced Materials | 🔬 Research Article
💡 This work pioneers medium-entropy-vacancy engineering in sodium-ion hybrid capacitors, using a Na3Fe0.6Al0.4V(PO4)3 cathode to reconcile the energy-power trade-off. It activates V4+/V5+ redox, creates oxygen vacancies for fast Na+ diffusion, and achieves 223 Wh/kg, 5940 W/kg, and 10,000-cycle stability. This offers a thermodynamic design blueprint for high-performance sodium energy storage.

💡 Asymmetric calcium single-atom catalysts break conventional symmetric d-block M-N4 geometry, strengthening iodide adsorption and accelerating iodide conversion kinetics. item.title: Operando and multiscale insights into the solid electrolyte interphase in lithium-mediated nitrogen reduction
item.description:
این مقاله با روش‌های operando و چندمقیاسی، بینش‌هایی درباره فصل مشترک الکترولیت جامد در احیای نیتروژن با واسطه لیتیوم ارائه می‌دهد.
Nature Reviews Chemistry | ⭐ Review
💡 This Review is the first to frame the solid electrolyte interphase as a dynamic regulator—not passive layer—governing Li+ transport, N2 access, and proton delivery in lithium-mediated nitrogen reduction. Its novelty lies in proposing an integrated operando, in situ, and multiscale characterization framework, combining complementary techniques to resolve SEI composition, structure, and evolution, thereby guiding rational SEI design for efficient, selective, durable ammonia electrosynthesis.
🏷 solid electrolyte interphase · lithium-mediated nitrogen reduction · operando · multiscale · SEI

item.title: Hidden Solid-Liquid Interfacial Failure Governs Fast-Charging Degradation in Large-Capacity Semi-Solid-State Lithium-Ion Batteries
item.description:

Journal of Materials Chemistry A | 🔬 Research Article
💡 This study reveals that hidden solid-liquid interfacial failure, not bulk degradation, drives fast-charging aging in large-capacity semi-solid-state lithium-ion batteries. By uncovering this interfacial mechanism, it provides critical insight for designing durable high-rate batteries, advancing practical fast-charging deployment of high-energy semi-solid-state systems.

💡 The novelty lies in synergistically coupling paraelectric phase engineering with boundary precipitation in NaNbO3-based ceramics. item.title: Medium‐Entropy Doping Stimulated Multielectron Redox for Ultrastable High‐Capacity Na 3 V 2 (PO 4 ) 3
item.description:

💡 Medium-entropy doping of NASICON Na₃V₂(PO₄)₃ activates the V⁴⁺/V⁵⁺ couple, enabling stepwise multielectron redox (Ti, Fe, V) over 1.5–4.6 V. This yields 160.1 mAh g⁻¹, 475 Wh kg⁻¹, and 100% capacity retention after 4000 cycles at 20 C, while reducing vanadium content. It establishes medium-entropy engineering as a viable strategy for high-performance polyanion cathodes.
🏷 sodium-ion battery · NASICON cathode · medium-entropy doping · multielectron redox · cycling stability

item.title: Supercapacitor Safety: Overcharge‐Induced Failure Mechanisms in Electrochemical Double‐Layer Capacitors
item.description:

Advanced Science | 🔬 Research Article | 🔓 Open Access
💡 This work provides the first direct, time-resolved visualization of EDLC overcharge failure, revealing a thermally driven pathway distinct from lithium-ion thermal runaway. By linking internal structural dynamics to external signatures, it identifies electrolyte decomposition, gas accumulation, and toxic vented species, exposing underappreciated fire and chemical hazards. This mechanistic insight is critical for safer high-power, high-reliability supercapacitor system design.

item.title: Revealing the Proton Slingshot Mechanism in Solid Acid Electrolytes through Machine-Learning Molecular Dynamics
item.description:
شبیه‌سازی‌های دینامیک مولکولی با میدان نیروی شبکه عصبی، مکانیسم «فلاخن پروتون» را در الکترولیت‌های اسید جامد CsH2PO4 و CsHSO4 نشان می‌دهند که چرخش پلی‌آنیون و بازآرایی پیوند O–H را ترکیب می‌کند.
Journal of the American Chemical Society | 🔬 Research Article
💡 Machine-learning molecular dynamics reveals a proton slingshot mechanism in solid acids: limited polyanion rotation plus O–H reorientation enables long-range proton jumps, refining the Grotthuss picture. It links polyanion rotation, proton coordination, and transport, showing proton concentration controls rotational frustration and conductivity—offering a design principle for faster solid electrolytes.
🏷 solid acid electrolyte · proton conduction · machine-learning MD · polyanion rotation · proton slingshot

item.title: Monomer Molecule Reconstruction Engineered Heterogeneous Lithium‐Ion Solvation for High‐Performance Lithium‐Metal Batteries
item.description:
بازسازی مونومر IBMA با افزایش ممانعت فضایی، سولواسیون Li+ را به سمت آنیون‌غنی هدایت کرده و الکترولیت ژلی DEE-PIBMA با هدایت 1.77 mS/cm و پایداری تا 4.7 V ارائه می‌دهد.
Angewandte Chemie International Edition | 🔬 Research Article
💡 In situ polymerization of IBMA amplifies steric hindrance, weakening Li⁺–polymer coordination and enabling anion-rich solvation at low salt concentrations. This molecule-reconstruction strategy, aided by TTE as a molecular lubricant, yields a gel electrolyte with 1.77 mS cm⁻¹ conductivity, 4.7 V stability, and 386.1 Wh kg⁻¹ pouch cells, establishing macromolecular backbone engineering as a general design principle for high-energy lithium-metal batteries.
🏷 lithium-metal battery · solvation structure · gel electrolyte · polymerization · high voltage

item.title: Chaotropic Anions Unlock the Zn-ion Redox in Vanadium Carbide MXene
item.description:
